text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After her performance, Silence Suzuka thanks the audience and stands still for a time, basking in the words of her fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her kindles a wish in me—that <chrname> will be just as encouraged by her fans' voices.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Light Hello renews her determination. She makes it her next mission to persuade all parties of the Grand Concert's importance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The first step will be to address the student body at Tracen Academy.
